cluster_fixture: Original Solr 8.11.4 SolrCloudTestCase: three Jetty nodes plus embedded ZooKeeper
target_code: for (String nodeName : liveNodes) try LISTALIASES and return; after every request fails, throw RuntimeException
coverage_kind: production method entries and branch outcome pairs in the instrumented Solr classes
review_scope: Unchanged three-node JUnit test and two observed HTTP2 request/response exception families, one to three exact faults per sequence
source_review: The selected throw is explicitly reached only after getAliases tries LISTALIASES on every liveNodes entry and each attempt raises a caught SolrServerException, RemoteSolrException or IOException. The healthy run and one/two-fault trials obtain aliases from a remaining node. Three matched faults exhaust all three entries; the selected RuntimeException and JUnit failure are the intended all-endpoints-failed behavior, not evidence of a new coordination bug.
stopping_reason: Six exact applied fault sequences reached the target after fault; both three-fault sequences triggered the selected exception, and the ConnectException sequence replayed. Source review establishes the all-endpoints-failed result is expected.
limitations: This conclusion is scoped to the original test and two tested exception families. Other workloads and fault types were not evaluated for this check.
